name: llguidance
description: Browser and Node.js WASM bindings for llguidance constrained decoding.

scripts.build:llguidance-wasm: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.88.0 wasm-pack build rust/llguidance-wasm --target web --release --out-dir ../../src/generation/grammar/wasm --out-name llguidance_wasm
scripts.build:llguidance-wasm:dev: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.88.0 wasm-pack build rust/llguidance-wasm --target web --dev --out-dir ../../src/generation/grammar/wasm --out-name llguidance_wasm
